# Bootstrap Grid 5.3.8

Official MIT-licensed distribution, stored locally so the layout does not depend on a runtime CDN.

Sources (tag pinned to v5.3.8):
- https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap-grid.min.css
- https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap-grid.min.css.map
- https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/v5.3.8/LICENSE

Loaded by care/page.html and care/no_plants.html using framework_styles in terrapeer/base.html.
Used in care/task_form.html and terrapeer/footer.html: row, g-3/g-4, col-12, col-md-6, col-md-3, row-cols-1, row-cols-sm-2, row-cols-lg-3.

This is the official grid-only build of Bootstrap, not a replacement stylesheet imitating Bootstrap. No Bootstrap JavaScript is needed for these CSS grid classes. Existing custom CSS controls appearance and existing JavaScript controls the care dialogs.
